scope: Independent read-only compatibility/error/lifetime review and local retained test archive/hash verification. No reviewer rerun, no SDK or device admission claim.
eligibility: Only static bind_interfaces and not bind_dynamic, concrete IPv4 excluding multicast/global broadcast, with address matching a non-tentative published DnsInterface.address. Unknown aliases, directed-broadcast targets, wildcard, IPv6 and generic protocol constructors retain packet-info behavior.
verified_behavior_boundaries: The socket caches its proven local IPv4 address once; unrelated later interface snapshots cannot mutate it. Initial and late listener factories both apply policy using their creation snapshot.
The generic, exclusive and DHCP constructors explicitly retain no cached DNS capability; TFTP and DHCP callers continue the original receiver.
Existing recvmsg errno/EAGAIN, MSG_TRUNC/MSG_CTRUNC, returned-length, peer decode and zero-source-port checks precede the new metadata branch unchanged.

Known static IPv4 admission does not require ingress; source filtering and configured local-service checks retain their original ordering. Static query logging/auth paths and send source=None do not require a receive interface index.
Reply sending, control allocation, packet buffer capacity, owner16-packet budget and terminal EAGAIN are unchanged.

Eligibility was deliberately narrowed after review found that explicit broadcast/multicast/unowned bindings may have ipi_spec_dst different from the bound address. No optimization was forced onto that ambiguity.
tests_reviewed: 10 real metadata/receive modes plus multicast/global-broadcast option controls preserve destination, peer, replies, EAGAIN, truncation and recovery.
Raw IPv4 UDP source-port-zero rejection followed by a valid datagram is checked for both generic and optimized receivers.
Initial socket policy persists when snapshot is cleared; new same-address late sockets derive fallback/fast policy from their own snapshot; dynamic rebind uses packet info.
Existing net ABI/cmsg/TCP ingress and UDP ACL tests remain in the22test retained run.
limitations: Native debug tests validate behavior, not performance or the exact SDK ELF.
No full acceptance rerun or device deployment was performed for this candidate.
Independent mechanism cost screen remains separate.
